fact: OMPIC says the 15-digit Identifiant Commun de l'Entreprise is one number used by all administrations alongside the commercial register, tax and CNSS numbers, mandatory on official documents from 1 July 2016.
OMPIC states its electronic company-creation platform is now in service nationwide, with over 12,000 firms created electronically since the February 2023 Rabat pilot.
